title: 학력인정학교지정규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Designation Standards)
The designation standards shall be as follows:
1. In the case of a private school, its founder shall be a corporation.
2. The student quota, number of school days, and other aspects of curriculum operation shall meet the following respective standards:
(a) A school referred to in Article 2 (1) 1: Standards equivalent to those applicable to elementary schools, middle schools, or high schools;
(b) A school referred to in Article 2 (1) 2: Standards equivalent to those applicable to junior colleges or universities.
3. School facilities, equipment, and basic property for generating revenue shall meet the following respective standards:
(a) A school referred to in Article 2 (1) 1: Standards under the Regulations on the Establishment and Operation of Schools at or Below the High School Level;
(b) A school referred to in Article 2 (1) 2: Standards under the Regulations on the Establishment and Operation of Universities.
